input.objective: Launch PLEA test run 8 on Sepolia from this Foundry repository exactly as launch.json lists it: five contracts (PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor, PleaLaunch), deployed in order in one transaction with the constructor arguments in launch.json. This is the final code rehearsed once more: run 7's code (branch testnet7 @ e1755aa, live as your launch #1843) plus (1) your run-7 adapt step's CabalGate size refactor, as delivered (no behaviour change); (2) the two Lows of run 7's launch audit, fixed: the Letterbox's 95% delivery floor is taken after the hook's 2% sale fees (HOOK_SALE_FEE_BPS 200), and Tribunal.standing checks the seller's exclusion before a pending objection; (3) the run-8 numbers: letters plead 20% (LETTER_SHARE_BPS 2000) and the fact score is 0-45: share of the balance sold at most 20%: 16, at most 35%: 9, more: 3; held 7 days: 7, 3 days: 4, 1 day: 2; at a loss: 13, gain at most 50%: 12, 200%: 10, 500%: 8, 1,000%: 6, more: 4 (exact band edges); PLEA that no buy record covers (claims, prizes) counts as held since trading opened, at profit 10; 24h trend up: 9, flat: 5, down: 0; need = 71 - fact (CannotPass above 45); (4) the fixes of your audit template's rounds 5 to 8 (audit/FINDINGS.md R5-* to R8-*; audit/rounds/5 to 8): two objections from different wallets may be pending at once (Tribunal Case.pending[2]); PleaLaunch's constructor refuses an oracle-fee setup the Letterbox would refuse and a zero or swapped Letterbox hash; seed waits for the hook, the Letterbox and the committed Tribunal; Tribunal.status counts the 1.2 seat multiplier; a plea larger than the seller's buy record takes the PLEA-weighted mean of the record's and the received-PLEA hold and profit points, to the nearest point; the gate's and the Tribunal's text checks refuse every Unicode format, variation-selector and default-ignorable character; PLEA the PoolManager cannot pay before a seller settles (a trim, the sale fee) is kept as ERC-6909 claims that rebalance burns; a partial fill's fee refund comes after the payouts; a Stacker without code falls back to plain-IMD cashback; the seed's dust burn is counted in totalBurned. Objection! (src/Tribunal.sol, spec OBJECTIONS.md; ownerless; deployed after the launch through PleaLaunch.deployTribunal(creationCode) against the keccak256 committed as PleaLaunch's 13th argument): for 20 minutes after an approval anyone except the seller and the wallets Seasons excludes may object (0.5 IMD oracle fee minted on Sepolia like the Letterbox's, a 0.35 IMD stake in pool IMD); a fresh panel re-scores the plea; sustained when newScore + 2 < need (no points, stake back), otherwise overruled (stake to the plea's season pot); no answer within 20 minutes voids it (stake back); the recorded score is the lowest any panel gave; at most two objections per plea, from different wallets; the sale is never touched and rulings never reset the dead-man. Unchanged from run 7: fees 2.0% (0.5% cashback, 0.75% owner, 0.25% prize pot, 0.25% wall, 0.25% of the PLEA burned), the 1.2 seat multiplier (Seasons' fourth argument, the IMD NFT (test) 0xa0443799c320e16c80801c9c1911f3571260287f), cap decay 15 days, the 82/6/12 split, six bonus seasons of 10,000,000 PLEA, top 25 from 450 to 350 bps. Build: the whole tree compiles under via_ir as one slow solc job: run forge build --skip test --skip script first (under a minute), then the tests in groups with forge test --match-path 'test/{A,B}.t.sol'; the default profile skips the fork, invariant and adversarial suites, which run under FOUNDRY_PROFILE=full one file at a time (the forks skip without their RPC URL variables); never a single forge build of the whole tree, it exceeds a 10-minute command limit. The suite is 823 tests in 89 suites; test/LaunchManifest.t.sol ties launch.json to both committed code hashes and asserts the launch fits the 16,777,216-gas cap with your factory's 22% headroom (13,494,931 as charged, 16,463,815 with headroom, 313,401 under). Audit the imported code and deploy it unchanged; fix only what the audit proves is a real bug, and keep every number as it is (timings, panel 30, quorum 17, 5-hour seasons, 33-hour dead-man, START 1792335600, credit gas 1300000, letters 20%, the fact table above, plea 1% to 50% or 2.5M, 0.70 IMD minimum plea value, 95% sale minimum, fee cap +10%, objection window 20 minutes, stake 0.35 IMD, margin 2, two objections per plea). If you change the Letterbox or the Tribunal, update its code hash in launch.json. Runtime sizes: PleaHook 24,402 bytes (174 under the EIP-170 limit), CabalGate 24,038, Letterbox 23,255, Tribunal 21,654, Seasons 12,473: keep any fix within them. Keep PLEA.setLauncher accepting either the deploy-transaction flag or PLEA's deployment block, and keep foundry.toml as it is, including the default profile's skip list, [lint] lint_on_build = false and the read-only fs_permissions for ./out and ./launch.json.
